verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built to be driven through the user's own AI agent. Its docs describe letting your agent handle incorporating, hiring and payroll, and asking the agent to call MCP tools. It ships first-party skill files for Codex and Claude Code; a hands-on dry run previewed both. It also offers a hosted MCP server and an agent-oriented JSON CLI. The product runs no model of its own, so it depends on the user's agent host to interpret language. missing for 10: no observed end-to-end natural-language session (the MCP endpoint never got past its auth wall in probes), no independent corroboration of conversational operation.
